question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate phrasal verb to fill in the blank.**

The driver very subtly ______ the traffic violation he committed.
solution:
The correct answer is '**ironed out**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase "**ironed out**" means to resolve or clear up (a problem or difficulty). (समस्या हल करना)
 
• The driver subtly resolved the issue related to the traffic violation he committed.
 
• The other options: "**ironed through**," "**ironed in**," and "**ironed aside**" do not fit the context as appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 3**'.

**Complete Sentence:** The driver very subtly ironed out__ the traffic violation he committed. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Ironed through**: not a commonly used phrasal verb in this context. 
 
• **Ironed in**: typically means to press into fabric, not applicable here. (कपड़े में दबाना)
 
• **Ironed aside**: not a standard phrasal verb in English.
